blurb: A Rhine town where Beethoven was born, and later the capital of West Germany.

facts.t: Beethoven was born in the attic of Bonngasse 20 in December 1770. The Beethoven-Haus keeps his last piano and his ear trumpets.

go: The fall of the Berlin Wall
facts.t: In 1949 Bonn, not Frankfurt, became the seat of West Germany's government, partly because Konrad Adenauer lived nearby. It stayed so until Berlin took over after reunification.
